name: Daily challenge generates, reviews and saves a role-specific problem
covers: curated fallback when AI generation quota is unavailable
description: Verifies a signed-in candidate can work through and revisit a daily challenge.
steps: Sign in and open Daily Challenge
Choose Software Developer and note the title
Refresh and confirm the title is unchanged for the India date
Submit an approach and request review
Open Saved & history, select the reviewed challenge, and verify its question and saved answer are restored
expected: The same daily problem remains for that role and date; reopening history restores the question, submitted answer and review, and the page discloses that code was not executed.

name: Job matching produces evidence-based resume actions
description: Checks the job-specific resume actions tab is available after analysis.
steps: Open Job matching and enter a complete job description
Inspect priority, section, evidence and copy wording
expected: Resume actions identify sections, priorities and evidence requirements, and Resumate opens the existing builder.

name: Learning roadmap supports up to 90 hours with a sustainability warning
description: Checks high weekly hours are accepted but flagged as demanding.
expected: The selector accepts 90, the warning is visible and the backend returns a plan with a weekly budget no higher than 90.

name: Daily challenge save and role separation work on mobile
description: Checks that role switching and saved challenge reopening work on a mobile screen.
steps: Open Saved & history, select the saved challenge, and verify its question is displayed
expected: The saved AI Engineer challenge reopens and the Software Developer challenge is a separate item.
